WITH s AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / SUM(s.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
  SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS numer,
  SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS denom
FROM s
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk;

SELECT

  COUNT(sr.sr_return_amt) AS matched_returns,

  COUNT(DISTINCT (s.ss_ticket_number, s.ss_item_sk)) AS distinct_sales
FROM s
